theorems.name: discover_keeps_live_leases
theorems.doc: **S.** A DISCOVER never takes a slot assigned to another client whose lease is still running.
theorems.statement:
theorem discover_keeps_live_leases (slots : Slice Slot) (cid : Std.U64) (txid : Std.U32) (now : Std.U64)
    (r : Option Std.Usize) (slots' : Slice Slot)
    (h : discover slots cid txid now = ok (r, slots')) :
    ∀ k, k < slots.val.length → (slots.val[k]!).kind = Kind.Assigned →
      (slots.val[k]!).id ≠ cid → now.val < (slots.val[k]!).lease_end.val →
      slots'.val[k]! = slots.val[k]!
theorems.proof:
theorem discover_keeps_live_leases (slots : Slice Slot) (cid : Std.U64) (txid : Std.U32) (now : Std.U64)
    (r : Option Std.Usize) (slots' : Slice Slot)
    (h : discover slots cid txid now = ok (r, slots')) :
    ∀ k, k < slots.val.length → (slots.val[k]!).kind = Kind.Assigned →
      (slots.val[k]!).id ≠ cid → now.val < (slots.val[k]!).lease_end.val →
      slots'.val[k]! = slots.val[k]! := by
  obtain ⟨res, hres, hp⟩ := (WP.spec_equiv_exists _ _).1
    (discover_loop_spec slots cid txid now none 0#usize (by simp) (by simp))
  unfold discover at h
  rw [hres] at h
  simp only [Result.ok.injEq] at h
  intro k hk h1 h2 h3
  have := hp k hk ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
  rw [h] at this
  exact this

theorems.name: request_acks_only_its_own
theorems.doc: **S.** A REQUEST is acknowledged only for a slot offered to this client with this transaction, or assigned to it with this transaction and an unexpired lease.
theorems.statement:
theorem request_acks_only_its_own (slots : Slice Slot) (cid : Std.U64) (txid : Std.U32) (now e : Std.U64)
    (i : Std.Usize) (slots' : Slice Slot)
    (h : request slots cid txid now e = ok (some i, slots')) :
    (slots.val[i.val]!).id = cid ∧ (slots.val[i.val]!).txid = txid ∧
      ((slots.val[i.val]!).kind = Kind.Offered ∨
        ((slots.val[i.val]!).kind = Kind.Assigned ∧ now.val < (slots.val[i.val]!).lease_end.val))
theorems.proof:
theorem request_acks_only_its_own (slots : Slice Slot) (cid : Std.U64) (txid : Std.U32) (now e : Std.U64)
    (i : Std.Usize) (slots' : Slice Slot)
    (h : request slots cid txid now e = ok (some i, slots')) :
    (slots.val[i.val]!).id = cid ∧ (slots.val[i.val]!).txid = txid ∧
      ((slots.val[i.val]!).kind = Kind.Offered ∨
        ((slots.val[i.val]!).kind = Kind.Assigned ∧ now.val < (slots.val[i.val]!).lease_end.val)) := by
  obtain ⟨res, hres, hp⟩ := (WP.spec_equiv_exists _ _).1
    (request_loop_spec slots cid txid now e 0#usize (by simp))
  unfold request at h
  rw [hres] at h
  simp only [Result.ok.injEq] at h
  subst h
  exact hp i rfl

theorems.name: answer_fits_bounds
theorems.doc: **S (U1 fix).** An answer is written only inside the received question and the buffer.
theorems.statement:
theorem answer_fits_bounds (rcv buf q : Std.Usize) (hq : q.val < 65536)
    (h : answer_fits rcv buf q = ok true) :
    12 + q.val ≤ rcv.val ∧ 12 + q.val + 16 ≤ buf.val
theorems.proof:
theorem answer_fits_bounds (rcv buf q : Std.Usize) (hq : q.val < 65536)
    (h : answer_fits rcv buf q = ok true) :
    12 + q.val ≤ rcv.val ∧ 12 + q.val + 16 ≤ buf.val := by
  have spec : answer_fits rcv buf q ⦃ r => r = true → 12 + q.val ≤ rcv.val ∧ 12 + q.val + 16 ≤ buf.val ⦄ := by
    unfold answer_fits DNS_HEADER_SIZE ANSWER_SIZE
    all_goals (try split)
    all_goals (try step*)
    all_goals (try split)
    all_goals (try step*)
    all_goals (try split)
    all_goals (try step*)
    all_goals (try split)
    all_goals (try step*)
    all_goals first | (intro h; simp_all; done) | (intro h; simp_all; scalar_tac) | scalar_tac
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hp⟩ := (WP.spec_equiv_exists _ _).1 spec
  rw [h] at hr
  simp only [Result.ok.injEq] at hr
  exact hp hr.symm

upstream.code:
/// a DNS header is 12 bytes
const DNS_HEADER_SIZE: usize = 12;

discover.lean:
@[reducible]
def discover
  (slots : Slice Slot) (cid : Std.U64) (txid : Std.U32) (now : Std.U64) :
  Result ((Option Std.Usize) × (Slice Slot))
  := do
  discover_loop slots cid txid now none 0#usize
discover.upstream_note: process_discover's slot choice; returns the slot index instead of sending the offer

upstream.code:
let answer_start = DNS_HEADER_SIZE + question_length;

        let ip_address_start = answer_start + 2 + 2 + 2 + 4 + 2;

ANSWER_SIZE.upstream_note: the 12 answer bytes before ip_address_start plus the 4-byte address transform_query_to_response writes

request.lean:
@[reducible]
def request
  (slots : Slice Slot) (cid : Std.U64) (txid : Std.U32) (now : Std.U64)
  (new_end : Std.U64) :
  Result ((Option Std.Usize) × (Slice Slot))
  := do
  request_loop slots cid txid now new_end 0#usize
request.upstream_note: process_request's ACK/NAK scan; Some(i) = ACK slot i, None = NAK

answer_fits.lean:
def answer_fits
  (received : Std.Usize) (buffer : Std.Usize) (question_len : Std.Usize) :
  Result Bool
  := do
  let «end» ← DNS_HEADER_SIZE + question_len
  if «end» <= received
  then let i ← «end» + ANSWER_SIZE
       ok (i <= buffer)
  else ok false
answer_fits.upstream_note: upstream has no check (U1): recv_from's length is ignored; guards transform_query_to_response on the whole buffer

Kind.lean:
@[discriminant isize]
inductive Kind where
| Free : Kind
| Offered : Kind
| Assigned : Kind
Kind.upstream_note: the variants of DhcpAssignment (Offered / Assigned / Free)

Slot.lean:
structure Slot where
  kind : Kind
  id : Std.U64
  txid : Std.U32
  lease_end : Std.U64
Slot.upstream_note: one DhcpAssignment of the assignments table, flattened (identifier as u64, Instant as u64 ticks)
